verdict.rationale: Sierra's docs mention configurable 'hand-off rules' as an experimentable behavior lever (sierra-docs-29) and general workflow/guardrail logic (sierra-docs-1, sierra-docs-6, sierra-docs-8), implying handoff configuration is possible, but there's no explicit documentation of granular triggers like topic, sentiment, customer tier, or explicit customer request, nor independent evidence that handoffs are reliably obeyed in practice. missing for 10: explicit multi-condition handoff configuration (topic/sentiment/tier/explicit-request), reliability/adherence testing or case studies, independent corroboration of handoff behavior.
